title: Rust: Palindrome Checker
description: Check if a string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards).

steps.title: Reverse a String
steps.description: Write a function `reverse(s: &str) -> String` that returns the reversed string. Call with `"hello"` and print.

steps.title: Simple Palindrome Check
steps.description: Write a function `is_palindrome(s: &str) -> bool` that checks if a string equals its reverse. Test with `"racecar"` and `"hello"`.
hints: If the string equals its reverse, it's a palindrome.
racecar reversed is racecar (palindrome!), hello is not.

steps.title: Case-Insensitive Check
steps.description: Modify `is_palindrome` to be case-insensitive. Test with `"Racecar"` and print result.
hints: Then check the lowercase version against its reverse.

verification.failureMessage: Check if 'Racecar' is a palindrome (it is).

steps.title: Ignore Non-Alphanumeric
steps.description: Modify `is_palindrome` to ignore spaces and punctuation. Test with `"A man a plan a canal panama"`.
hints: Then convert to lowercase and check.

steps.title: Find Palindromes in Array
steps.description: Given `["level", "world", "radar", "rust", "madam"]`, find and print all palindromes.
hints: Iterate over the array with a for loop.

verification.failureMessage: Print all palindrome words from the array.
